# Architecture diagrams: OSDU Delivery in the C4 model

<!-- Generated by tools/c4/render.py from osdu/docs/reference/architecture/c4-model.yaml. Edit the model and render again. -->

OSDU Delivery drawn in the [C4 model](https://c4model.com): who uses it and what it relies on, the containers it runs
as, the components inside the three that hold its logic, how a record, a question and a commit move through them,
and what the Terraform in `osdu/deploy/terraform` creates on Azure. Start with the system context and read down the
list. On every page, the line on top leads to the start, the views it zooms out of and the views it zooms into; the
line at its foot leads to the view before and after it here.

Every diagram follows the [C4 notation checklist](https://c4model.com/diagrams/checklist): a title naming its type
and scope, every element with its name, its type and technology and what it does, every line with what it does and
how, and a key to every colour, shape, icon, border and line style it uses. The diagrams are dark; each page links
its light version, and the deck comes in both. How the module meets SQLFlow underneath is
[the architecture page](../concepts/architecture.md).

## The views

| Level | View | What it answers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| C4 Level 1 · System Context | [System Context diagram for OSDU Delivery](system-context.md) | Who uses OSDU Delivery, where its data comes from and goes, and what it relies on. |
| C4 Level 2 · Containers | [Container diagram for OSDU Delivery](containers.md) | The nine deployable parts, what each runs, and how they reach each other and the systems around them. |
| C4 Level 2 · AI Usage | [Container diagram for OSDU Delivery, every path to an AI model](ai-usage.md) | Every place a model is called, what it is sent, and the fences around it. |
| C4 Level 3 · Components | [Component diagram for the control plane](control-plane.md) | Inside the control plane: the API, the node protocol, the scheduler, the sync, direct operations and the assistant. |
| C4 Level 3 · Components | [Component diagram for the compute node](compute-node.md) | Inside a node: how a run lands files, keys rows, renders records, sends them and writes the ledger. |
| C4 Level 3 · Components | [Component diagram for the MCP server](mcp-server.md) | Inside the MCP server: two transports, one set of rules, estate and data tools, the documentation. |
| C4 Dynamic · Data | [Dynamic diagram: a source row becomes an OSDU record](record-delivery.md) | One record's path, numbered: from a dropped file to the OSDU id and version the ledger keeps. |
| C4 Dynamic · AI | [Dynamic diagram: a ! question answered from approved data](question.md) | A data question, numbered: delegated token, model, MCP tools, the column guard, a node's read-only query. |
| C4 Dynamic · Git | [Dynamic diagram: a commit becomes the runs that execute it](git-integration.md) | Git, numbered: push, a trigger proved by GitHub's token, the App's short-lived tokens, the sync, the pinned checkout. |
| C4 Deployment · Azure | [Deployment diagram for OSDU Delivery on Azure Container Apps](deployment-azure.md) | What osdu/deploy/terraform creates: four container apps, Azure SQL, ADLS, Key Vault, AI Foundry, identities. |

## The files

- **The deck:** [osdu-delivery-c4.pptx](osdu-delivery-c4.pptx), and in light [osdu-delivery-c4-light.pptx](osdu-delivery-c4-light.pptx). One slide a view, in the order above; a click on an element marked *view inside* opens the slide of its inside, and every slide links back to the map of views.
- **The diagrams:** one SVG a view in [svg](svg), named after its page (`<view>.svg`), and in light `<view>-light.svg`. Each page shows the dark one and links the light one.
- **The model:** [c4-model.yaml](c4-model.yaml), the one source: every element once, and every view that places them. Change it and render again; never edit an SVG, a page or a slide by hand.
- **The renderer:** [tools/c4](../../../../tools/c4), with how to render the model, the notation it follows, and the icons and their terms.
